Definition: a stream (as flowing); also an ear of grain (as growing out); by analogy, a branch
BiblicalUsage: Joseph dreams of seven ears of grain on one stalk, and the men of Gilead test the men of Ephraim at the fords of Jordan with a single word: say Shibboleth.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that one word can tell where a man belongs, and the men of Ephraim found that out at the river.
